{{Quote|The Jedi Master possessed a secret―the location of the Foundry, an ancient space station of untold power.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
The '''Foundry''' was an ancient alien [[Space station/Legends|space station]] embedded inside an asteroid.

==Description==
{{Quote|The Foundry's specifications match those of three other space stations known by history. Each of these legendary stations could manufacture technology on a massive scale. One xenoformed planets; another built fleets of ships. [...] The Foundry creates endless armies of droids.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
The Foundry was an engineering marvel that was built into a massive [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] situated in the long-forgotten [[Nanth'ri system/Legends|Nanth'ri system]]. It consisted of at least twelve manufacturing levels, according to data obtained by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], that were each capable of producing thousands of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. A series of vast tunnels honeycombed the asteroid, which suggested that automated [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droids]] were used to excavate the interior of any useful ores. The [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] believed that the facility used a network of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to capture and break down nearby asteroids to provide new raw material for its endless mass production.<ref name="TORC" />

==History==
{{Quote|I know the history of war&mdash;and three times, space stations matching the Foundry's specifications have changed the course of nations.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
This facility was believed to have been built before 23,000 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] by a [[Rakata/Legends|long-forgotten alien species]]. The specifications matched those of three other space stations that had been discovered by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, all possessing tremendous power. These stations included the [[Star Forge]] and [[Rakatan xenoforming station|another facility]] that was capable of [[Terraforming/Legends|xenoforming]] entire worlds. The full extent of the production capabilities of the Foundry were unknown, though it was believed it was able to change [[The galaxy/Legends|the entire galaxy]].<ref name="TORC" />

[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was aware of the existence of the Foundry and kept that knowledge hidden from the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. After he was [[Battle of the Maelstrom|rescued]]<ref name="TOR:CtA" /> from [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]] prison,<ref name="TOR:MP">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Maelstrom Prison}}</ref> he traveled to the facility, where he intended to unleash an army of [[extermination droid]]s against the Sith Empire to eliminate the threat posed by the Emperor.<ref name="TOR:TF" /> However, [[Darth Malgus]] learned of Revan's location and ordered [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Phennir (Moff)|Phennir]] to assemble a strike force. After the [[Attack on the Dorin's Sky|attack on the ''Dorin's Sky'']], the Imperials acquired a way to sneak inside the station on the captured Republic ship.<ref name="TOR:CtA" /> Helm officer [[Martos]] stayed behind while a strike team stormed through the Foundry, defeating Revan's personal droid [[HK-47]]. Eventually the strike team reached Revan and engaged him in a fierce fight, at the end of which the Master of the Foundry disappeared in a bright flash of light. The [[battle of the Foundry]] was won by the Empire,<ref name="TOR:TF" /> and Darth Malgus handed it over to the [[Schism Collective]], who rebuilt HK-47 from its remains and later incorporated several of the Foundry's capabilities into the Emperor's personal space station.<ref name="TOR:TFE">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref>
